scope: Align agent settings and usage in the details panel
limitations: Headless WebKit with isolated observations. Native OS input, assistive technology and Rust command integration were not exercised.

conversation--agent-details-compact-dark.task: Inspect configuration and usage with clear labels and compact controls.
conversation--agent-details-compact-dark.observations: The 9% context meter, 18,400 / 200,000 token count and $0.42 spending are visible beside their labels. Provider and model controls use a restrained hierarchy. The compact details screen is scrolled to Agent settings with its title and close action retained. Dark text and controls remain clear.
